-No application code has been added yet.
+NIT-265 adds a bounded local Neatlogs replica: landing, fictional project entry, trace list, span details, tree and timeline. Every session contains two deterministic order lookup fixtures. Visitor text is saved; it does not generate personalization. No LLM or agent runs.
+
+## Run the replica
+
+Use Node >=26.7.0 and npm >=11.19.0 on the personal Mac.
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npx playwright install chromium # once, for browser tests
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open http://127.0.0.1:4321. The server binds loopback only. It deliberately does not load `.env.local` or use the Neatlogs key. Existing real SDK integration remains separate; do not mistake the replica fixtures for real Tailor execution telemetry.
+
+For developer inspection and proposal validation, start the server with a local key, then use the same environment in another terminal:
+
+```sh
+export TAILOR_DEV_KEY="$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(require("node:crypto").randomBytes(32).toString("hex"))')"
+npm run dev
+# In a terminal with the same TAILOR_DEV_KEY:
+npm run fixture -- validate
+npm run fixture -- inspect
+```
+
+`validate` creates two fictional sessions, rejects a broken parent, verifies unchanged state, publishes a corrected supported fixture at v2, independently reads it back, rejects stale v1 and denies another session's read/write. `inspect` returns saved descriptions, scenario/version and canonical records; it requires the developer key. Never use real buyer input. `TAILOR_URL` selects another loopback port; `PORT` changes the server port; `TAILOR_DATA_PATH` changes the SQLite file.
+
+Data lives in gitignored `.local/tailor.sqlite` with SQLite WAL/SHM sidecars. The directory is private (0700 when created); the persisted signing secret lets the browser's HttpOnly/SameSite cookie survive a server restart. A cookie grants one session only. A new session replaces that browser's cookie; older sessions remain available to authorized developer inspection. Full auth, sharing and retention policy are outside this local fictional proof. Nothing automatically expires from SQLite; manually reset after review, with the server stopped:
+
+```sh
+rm -f .local/tailor.sqlite .local/tailor.sqlite-wal .local/tailor.sqlite-shm
+# Optional browser-test dataset reset, also with its server stopped:
+rm -f .local/ui-test.sqlite .local/ui-test.sqlite-wal .local/ui-test.sqlite-shm
+```
+
+These commands destroy only the named local fictional datasets and invalidate their cookies; do not point the server at buyer data. No reset was applied to the primary checkout or another worktree.
+
+## Checks
+
+```sh
+npm run typecheck
+npm test
+npm run build
+npm run test:ui
+npm run doctor:local
+```
+
+There is no lint script. Browser screenshots default to `test-results/evidence`; set `TAILOR_SCREENSHOT_DIR` to a review folder to preserve them. Tests use disposable fictional data, local request interruption/failure simulation and a test-only developer key. The HTTP tests close/reopen the database/server to verify restart persistence, full-document rollback, concurrent CAS conflicts and cross-session denial.
+
+`doctor:probe`, `env:check` and `smoke:trace` retain their existing meanings in AGENTS.md. Authenticated probing and synthetic real trace ingestion were not run for NIT-265 because the real account is read-only for this task. `neatlogs` remains pinned to 1.1.28. `npm audit` reports 10 moderate and 4 high advisories in its existing SDK/OpenTelemetry/protobuf dependency chain; this slice does not upgrade that integration.
+
+## API contract
+
+Types live in `src/contracts.ts`; all UI projections originate in the session's single canonical dataset. Cookies and developer keys are never embedded in frontend code. Every response is `no-store`. Errors are `{ error: { code, message } }`.
+
+| Method/path | Contract |
+| --- | --- |
+| POST `/api/sessions` | `{description, scenario}` plus `Idempotency-Key` (16–80 alphanumeric/hyphen characters); 201 session + HttpOnly cookie. Exact retries return the original session; conflicting input returns 409. |
+| GET `/api/session` | Current browser's canonical session. |
+| GET `/api/sessions/:id` | Cookie-owned canonical session including saved description, version and active fixture. |
+| GET `/api/sessions/:id/traces` | `{version, activeScenario, total, filtered, traces}`. Supports `q`, `scenario`, `detection=yes/no`, `tag`, `minMs`, `maxMs`. Search is case-insensitive canonical JSON substring; latency uses milliseconds. |
+| GET `/api/sessions/:id/traces/:traceId` | `{version, trace}` including flat parent-linked spans, I/O, errors and timing. |
+| GET `/api/sessions/:id/traces/:traceId/spans/:spanId` | `{version, span}`. |
+| GET `/api/dev/sessions` | Developer key header `x-tailor-dev-key`; inspect all saved local fictional sessions. |
+| POST `/api/dev/sessions/:id/proposal` | Developer key AND owning cookie. `{expectedVersion, dataset}`; 200 accepted canonical session. Only exact supported fixtures with either active scenario validate. Immutable ownership/input/IDs; no arbitrary personalization. |
+
+Transactions publish a complete validated document or nothing. Invalid fixture 422, stale version 409, unknown/cross-session ID 404, missing developer key 403, unsupported method 405, unsupported filter 400, malformed JSON 400, content type 415 and >32KB body 413. Disconnects retain the last accepted version. Supported browser URLs are `/demo/:id/traces`, `/demo/:id/traces/:traceId` and detail `?span=:spanId`.
+
+See [reference and deviation notes](docs/nit-265-reference.md) for current-product observations and review boundaries.

+# NIT-265 reference and verification
+
+Reference inspected read-only in Comet on Nitin's personal Mac, 11 October 2026. Public https://neatlogs.com and authenticated Tailor Demo Sandbox trace list, recovered/exhausted detail, errors, graph, timeline, tag search, no-match search and latency filter. The retained six original preflight references and four later safe crops are outside the repository in the dated Codex visualization review folder for session `01a128b8-8734-7721-9f61-4697417b9557`.

Replica desktop capture uses 3127×1204 CSS pixels, approximately corresponding to that scale; comparison images normalize the reference raster to this frame and explicitly label normalization. This is visual comparison evidence, not independently measured identical CSS viewports or pixel parity. Replica mobile checks use 390×844; a real responsive mobile reference was not inspected. Loading was transient during native navigation; a persistent real backend failure was not induced. Local loading/failure/interruption states are tested separately.
+
+## Observed semantics and structure
+
+- Public: cyan hackathon strip, sparse top navigation, gray first hero sentence above heavy black second sentence, silver San Francisco bridge/city/fog scene, dark setup button and outlined entry CTA.
+- App: narrow pale icon rail, Traces title/tabs and right search/date/refresh controls, capsule filters, daily histogram, dense table, bottom row count/pagination. Columns: selection, Ingested at, Status, Detections, Evals, Input, Output, Comments, Replay.
+- Trace: timestamp/back toolbar; navigator, graph/timeline toggles; right-aligned input bubble over centered expandable parent-linked steps; root output below. Graph occupies the right pane. Timeline occupies a horizontal bottom pane, gray successful bars and red errors. Native graph selection highlighted a node/row without opening inline detail; inline span expansion displayed I/O/error/attributes.
+- Ready indicates processing, not final task success. The 43ms recovered reference has one ERROR child and no Execution Failed detection. The exhausted 50ms header/51ms root reference has two ERROR children and two detections; root output safely escalates. Replica avoids that header/root rounding difference by deriving all durations from the same record.
+- Source tagged list showed 10 baseline traces. Search `timeout-recovered` settled at 2 matching rows with span match chips; `zz-no-fictional-trace` showed “No traces found / Try adjusting your filters or date range.” Latency greater than .045 seconds showed 2 exhausted rows. Counts change with filtering. Optional expansion failures and Analytics were not investigated.
+
+## Bounded differences for review
+
+- Landing reproduces the first-screen composition only, not the full scrolling marketing site. Entry CTA replaces Start free; other marketing links and setup action explicitly announce unavailable scope. Static sourced photographic assets replace the real site's animated layered atmosphere; no motion parity claim.
+- Synthetic/session/version notice is added. There are two controlled order lookup fixtures, not the source catalogue/refund flow. Saved project text never drives fixtures; IDs are session-scoped stable UUID-derived records.
+- Relevant fixture/detection/tag/search/latency controls work; session/user/workflow/eval/metadata/advanced filtering, date selection, display menus and broader app routes are outside scope. Capsule filters are native selectors rather than the incumbent's popover editor. Search uses substring rather than ranked matching/span chips. Evals/comments columns are empty; no evaluation is fabricated.
+- Navigator is a two-trace selector rather than paged reference tabs. Graph preserves root/child relationships in a fixed right pane rather than draggable canvas/splitters. Selection opens the corresponding inline span and marks it; direct links use `?span=`. Timeline has explicit duration labels and is derived from coherent offsets. No live replay, comments, assistant or side effects are offered.
+- Typography/spacing/icon drawings are hand-reconstructed from observation using sourced Geist. Dense tables scroll horizontally on mobile; other content fits 390px. Dark theme is local and approximate, not reference-certified.
+
+## Assets and implementation boundaries
+
+`public/assets/landscape.webp` and `portrait.webp` were fetched 11 October from the public Neatlogs `/hero-silver/mobile-scene-landscape-v1.webp` and `/hero-silver/mobile-scene-portrait-v1.webp`; `geist.woff2` is the public site's Geist font asset. Used only for this local review replica, not a claim of redistribution/licensing or deployment permission. No authenticated cookies/assets were fetched by scripts. Frontend/runtime requests stay local. Node HTTP, native SQLite and strict TypeScript avoid an application framework for this small two-fixture slice; Playwright is development-only.
+
+Existing SDK setup tests and network-free Doctor pass. Real Tailor→Neatlogs execution telemetry remains configured separately and unmodified; authenticated telemetry health was not newly verified. Local synthetic replica data is not proof of that ingestion.
